layout_notes: 720x1280 portrait canvas. Top ~51% (y 0-0.50): a crop of the landscape game, zoomed so the left and right edges of the game are cut off (top-left result-screen text and rank are cut). Directly below it (y ~0.50-0.54, x 0-0.45): a second crop of the phone screen showing the game's 'Remaining NN | Eliminations N' counter (on the spawn island it reads 'Players NN'; outside matches it shows lobby/loading pixels). Below that a red-on-white 'NEW GAMING KEYBOARD & MOUSE GOAL' banner (covers the lower half of the rank text on result screens), a 'TODAYS TOP SUPPORTER' line, then the face cam with a counter box and a QR code (y ~0.62-1.0). The game is fed by a phone screen-mirroring app; when it reconnects, the game area goes black or shows the mirroring app's help screen. All matches are Ranked classic Erangel with the 'Midnight Hunters' theme, which has respawns: the streamer can die, spectate for a few seconds and come back (respawn countdown or recall by plane) inside the same match.
